test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 02 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In April 2025, Rapido signed a Memorandum of Understanding with the Ministry of Labour and Employment to provide jobs through which of the following government portals?
solution:
The correct answer is __**National Career Service Portal**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Rapido**, a leading bike-taxi aggregator, signed a **Memorandum of Understanding (MoU)** with the **Ministry of Labour and Employment** in **April 2025**.
 
• The MoU focuses on providing employment opportunities via the **National Career Service (NCS) Portal**, which is an initiative under the Ministry of Labour and Employment, Government of India.
 
• The **National Career Service Portal** is a comprehensive platform that connects job seekers with employers across multiple sectors, including unorganized and gig-based work.
 
• The platform aims to facilitate **job creation and skill matching** for individuals, especially in the age group of 16 to 60 years.
 
• This partnership aligns with the government’s efforts to promote **digital employment services** and reduce unemployment by leveraging technology for job facilitation.
 
• The **National Career Service (NCS) Portal** also provides features like career counseling, skill development programs, and job fairs to enhance employability.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **National Career Service Portal:**

 
 
• The **NCS Portal** was launched on **July 20, 2015**, by the Ministry of Labour and Employment.
 
• It acts as a **one-stop platform** for job seekers, employers, counselors, and training providers to connect and fulfill employment-related needs.
 
• The portal offers services such as **job matching, career guidance, vocational training, and internships**.
 
• It caters to various groups, including **students, fresh graduates, experienced professionals, and those in the informal sector**.
 
• As of 2023, the portal has registered **more than 10 million job seekers and 1.5 lakh employers**.
 
 
 
• **Other Government Portals:**
 
 
• **Startup India Portal:** This platform supports startups by providing resources like funding schemes, mentorship, and regulatory assistance. It was launched in **2016** under the **Startup India Initiative**.
 
• **Digital India Portal:** Aims to transform India into a **digitally empowered society** by offering e-governance services, digital literacy programs, and internet access in rural areas.
 
• **Skill India Portal:** Launched under the **Skill India Mission** in **2015**, it focuses on **enhancing vocational training** and certifications to improve employability.
 
 
 
• **Rapido:**
 
 
• **Rapido** is a prominent bike taxi and delivery service in India, established in **2015**.
 
• Its services cater to individuals seeking **affordable and quick transportation** across urban and semi-urban areas.
 
• By collaborating with government initiatives like the NCS Portal, Rapido contributes to **job creation** and the growth of the gig economy.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Key Functions of the National Career Service Portal:**

 
 
• Provides **real-time job matching** based on a candidate’s skills, experience, and preferences.
 
• Hosts **job fairs** across the country to connect employers and job seekers.
 
• Offers **career counseling** services through certified counselors and helpline support.
 
• Features an integrated platform for **skill training programs** in collaboration with the **Skill India Mission**.
 
• Enables job seekers to create detailed profiles and employers to post job openings.
 
 
 
• **Gig Economy and Employment:**
 
 
• The gig economy refers to a labor market characterized by **short-term contracts** and freelance work.
 
• Platforms like Rapido and others in the gig sector play a vital role in providing employment opportunities to **youth and part-time workers**.
 
• By integrating with government portals like the NCS, these platforms can enhance job accessibility and provide a **structured approach** to informal employment.
